component.name: M3UTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(url) http.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.InitClientCertificates() http.AddHeader("User-Agent", "Roku/1.0") port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") http.SetMessagePort(port)
tmpFile = "cachefs:/mc_playlist.m3u" http.AsyncGetToFile(tmpFile)
msg = Wait(120000, port) if msg = invalid m.top.error = "Download timeout" return end if code = msg.GetResponseCode() if code < 200 or code >= 300 m.top.error = "HTTP " + stri(code).trim() return end if
content = ReadAsciiFile(tmpFile) if content = "" m.top.error = "Empty file" return end if
' --- C++ LEVERAGED ULTRA-FAST REGEX PARSER --- ' Instead of looping line-by-line, we extract the #EXTINF and URL lines ' simultaneously via optimized global regex patterns. regex = CreateObject("roRegex", "(#EXTINF:[^\r\n]*group-title=""([^""]*)"")[^\r\n]*tvg-logo=""([^""]*)"")[^\r\n]*,([^\r\n]*)\s*(https?://[^\s]*)", "i") matches = regex.MatchAll(content)
channels = [] groupsSeen = {} groups = [] maxCh = 3000 ' Cap at 3k lines to ensure memory buffer safety
for each match in matches if channels.count() >= maxCh then exit for
name = Trim(match[4]) url = Trim(match[5]) grp = Trim(match[2]) logo = Trim(match[3])
if name = "" then name = "Channel " + stri(channels.count() + 1).trim() if grp = "" then grp = "Uncategorized"
if url <> "" channels.push({ name: name, url: url, group: grp, logo: logo })
if not groupsSeen.doesExist(grp) groupsSeen[grp] = true groups.push(grp) end if end if end for
' Free heavy global string allocations immediately content = "" matches = invalid
if channels.count() = 0 m.top.error = "Zero channels parsed. Verify M3U structure format." return end if
m.top.channelsJson = FormatJson(channels) m.top.groupsJson = FormatJson(groups) end sub
function buildChannel(extinf as String, url as String) as Object ch = {} ch.url = url grp = attrVal(extinf, "group-title") ch.logo = attrVal(extinf, "tvg-logo") name = lastCommaVal(extinf) if name = "" then name = "Unknown" ch.name = name if grp = "" first = UCase(Left(name, 1)) if first >= "A" and first <= "Z" grp = first else grp = "#" end if end if ch.group = grp return ch end function
function lastCommaVal(line as String) as String lastPos = 0 cur = Instr(1, line, ",") while cur > 0 lastPos = cur cur = Instr(cur + 1, line, ",") end while if lastPos = 0 then return "" val = Trim(Mid(line, lastPos + 1, Len(line) - lastPos)) if Left(val, 7) = "#EXTINF" then return "" return val end function
function attrVal(line as String, attr as String) as String needle = attr + "=" + chr(34) startPos = Instr(1, line, needle) if startPos = 0 then return "" valStart = startPos + Len(needle) valEnd = Instr(valStart, line, chr(34)) if valEnd = 0 then return "" return Mid(line, valStart, valEnd - valStart) end function
